sources.title: Aurora (2025) - IMDb
sources.snippet: Aurora: Directed by Andres Maimik, Rain Tolk. With Maarja Johanna Mägi, Ott Kartau, Jörgen Liik, Kersti Heinloo. Aurora, the daughter of a religious leader, enters into a secret affair that changes her life. She tries to please everyone but when it's time for a lavish wedding anniversary celebration, an uninvited guest arrives.
